about: The bad-beat jackpot's pools (scope-v1 module 8; additions, "Jackpot sub-pools"). A drop splits between the main, season and freeroll pools: the season and freeroll pools take their shares of the drop rounded down to the paisa, and the main pool takes the rest, so the parts always add up to the drop. With no shares set, the whole drop goes to the main pool. Nothing ever rounds up.

cases.description: No shares set: the whole ₹100 drop goes to the main pool.
A ₹100 drop at 20% season and 10% freeroll: ₹70, ₹20 and ₹10.
Thirds: season and freeroll take 33.33% each, rounded down to ₹33.33, and the main pool takes the ₹33.34 left.
A ₹150 drop at 15% season and 5% freeroll: shares in paise, ₹120, ₹22.50 and ₹7.50.
